mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (product_id, user_id, created_at, created_by) VALUES (#{productId}, #{userId}, NOW(), #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id AS cartId, c.product_id AS productId, p.name AS name, p.category_id AS categoryId, cat.name AS categoryName, p.shipping_price AS shippingPrice, (SELECT pi.url FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id AND pi.image_type = 'GALLERY' ORDER BY pi.sort_order LIMIT 1) AS thumbnailUrl FROM cart c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN category cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ci.cart_item_id AS cartItemId, ci.cart_id AS cartId, ci.quantity AS quantity, ci.product_variant_id AS productVariantId, v.product_id AS productId, v.option_label AS optionLabel, v.price AS price, v.status AS status FROM cart_item ci LEFT JOIN product_variant v ON ci.product_variant_id = v.product_variant_id WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY v.sort_order, v.option_label
